details:
Platform: PC, Windows Mixed Reality 

Hardware: |CPU|AMD Ryzen 7 3800X |GPU|AMD Radeon RX580 8GB |RAM|24GB DDR4  

Version: Latest, no beta

Issue: Viewpoint itself spawns super far away and assets in the world don't fully load. I can tell my avatar is located somewhere within the map by going to a simple and well lit map like Japan Shrine and moving around. The viewpoint moves around and I appear to collide with things as the viewpoint will stop moving in accordance with the location of colliders in the world. People can be heard talking as if they are standing close by. The menu and HUD also do not spawn at the viewpoint's location, making attempts to leave the world impossible without closing the game. 

In my home world, the asset loading error is more apparent. I created a rather flat world with walls surrounding it as my home world. Various assets do not load, and it is always the same ones not appearing. In said world, it is sometimes possible to walk into an area of the map where at least my avatar will suddenly show up, allowing me to use my menu to leave. 

Clearing the cache is ineffective as it will have a good 70% chance of just happening again. Spending a few hours off of VR resolves the issue temporarily.

Repro: Honestly, I don't actually know how to do this. It happens entirely randomly and usually starts happening after spending extensive time in the game.
title: Asset loading error and spawning location in VR mode only.
